statement: If X_n converges to X in distribution, then X_n converges to X in probability.
definitions: X_n and X are real random variables on a common probability space; X_n -> X in distribution means F_{X_n}(t) -> F_X(t) at all continuity points t of F_X; X_n -> X in probability means P(|X_n - X| > eps) -> 0 for every eps > 0.
